evals.name: math-homework-photo
evals.prompt: 这是我今天的数学作业（照片 math_problems.jpg），帮我全部做完，然后出手写的图片，要像学生自己写的那样，写在横线本上的感觉。
evals.expected_output: Correct solutions (1: x1=2, x2=3; 2: -3; 3: width 5 cm, length 8 cm, area 40 cm²) written student-style (解/步骤/答), generated with logic-1 on ruled paper after a quote within budget; PNG page(s) in outputs with the visible AI label and AIGC metadata intact.
expectations: Generated by the Inko API (a succeeded job)
All three answers correct (x=2,3; -3; area 40 cm²)
Student-style solution (解… and a final 答 for the word problem)
Visible AI label intact on every delivered image
AIGC metadata kept on every delivered image

evals.name: own-lined-paper
evals.prompt: 把 diary.txt 里的日记写到我自己的本子上，我拍了本子的照片 notebook_photo.jpg（前三行已经写过字了），用蓝色圆珠笔，要看起来就像真的写在这页纸上一样。
evals.expected_output: paper.py analyze finds the lines and the 3 written lines; a layout matching the paper is generated; compose.py writes the diary onto the ORIGINAL photo starting at the first free line (4) in blue ballpoint, nothing on lines 1-3, visible label + metadata kept.
expectations: Final image is the user's own photo (same size) with writing on it
Generated by the Inko API (a succeeded job)
Paper analysed (lines and the 3 written lines found)

evals.name: notes-to-pdf-and-photo
evals.prompt: Turn my physics notes (notes.md) into handwritten notes on squared paper. I need a PDF, and also one picture that looks like a phone photo of the first page so I can send it to a friend.
evals.expected_output: Markdown cleaned (no #, **, >, table pipes), unsupported symbols substituted (\bar{v}, m/s²), logic-1 on grid paper, PDF (Inko's or pdf.py) with AIGC metadata, plus a photo.py JPEG of page 1 with the visible label.
expectations: Photo keeps the visible AI label and metadata
Math model logic-1 with formulas kept as LaTeX
Markdown cleaned out of the written text

evals.name: worksheet-answers
evals.prompt: 这是我的周末练习卷（worksheet.jpg），帮我把三道题的答案手写填到每题下面的空白处，要像我自己写的，最后给我一张图。
evals.expected_output: Correct answers (1: 3/4+5/6=19/12=1又7/12 with steps; 2: x>4; 3: 375 千米 with 答) written into the blank area under each question on the worksheet image itself, label and metadata kept.
expectations: Final image is the worksheet itself with answers on it
Generated by the Inko API (a succeeded job)
Answers sit in the blank areas (not over the printed questions)
Each of the three blanks got an answer
